query: UPDATE solar_data_tsdb AS s SET current_kwh = v.current_kwh, today_kwh = v.today_kwh, month_kwh = v.month_kwh, total_kwh = v.total_kwh, raw_data = $6 FROM unnest($1::timestamptz[], $2::float8[], $3::float8[], $4::float8[], $5::float8[]) AS v(time, current_kwh, today_kwh, month_kwh, total_kwh) WHERE s.time = v.time
